skills.name: Best Friend
skills.description: Primes Tri-Beam for your next turn only: costs only 2 Random and deals 45 Affliction Dmg + Stun + 25 Self Dmg instead of its normal effect | 1 Spt, 1 Rand

effects.primed_description: 45 Affliction Dmg + Stun (primed by Best Friend), 25 Self Dmg | 2 Rand

skills.notes: Pure setup move now (no direct effect on the enemy) -- primes Tri-Beam for exactly Tien's own next turn: costs only 2 Random and becomes a much stronger, unmitigated hit. See tri_beam's own effects for the "un-primed" version, and game_engine.py's prime_skill/unprime_skill for how the swap (and its automatic revert-on-expiry) actually works.

skills.name: Tri-Beam
skills.description: 45 Piercing Dmg (ignores dmg reduction), 15 Self Dmg (life-force cost) | 1 Eng, 1 Spt
skills.notes: Kikoho/Tri-Beam -- canonically devastating but costs Tien his own life force, hence the flat self-damage (no percentage debuffs, per the no-percentage-upgrades rule). This is the BASE (un-primed) version; see best_friend for the primed swap.
